dashboard.description: vocus.cc 技術 SEO 倉儲。三條每小時／每日自動寫入的管線：Core Web Vitals、Google 搜尋成效、爬蟲與 AI bot。資料源走唯讀角色 seo_dashboard_ro，只有六張表的 SELECT 權限。

panels.description: 這一格是整張儀表板存在的理由。管線停掉時不會有人來通知——只有這裡的「距今小時」會慢慢變大。2026-08 曾有一條管線停了三天沒人發現，因為它的告警住在那支從未被執行的檔案裡。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT table_name AS "管線",
       max(finished_at) AS "最後成功寫入",
       round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(finished_at)))/3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS "距今小時"
FROM ingestion_run WHERE status = 'success'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: 管線最後一次成功寫入

panels.description: 裝上這條管線之前，沒有人知道答案。AI 爬蟲的量長期高於 Googlebot 全家加總。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, metric, sum(request_count)::bigint AS value
FROM (
  SELECT (date::timestamp + (hour || ' hours')::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS ts,
         request_count,
         CASE WHEN ua_group LIKE 'ai-%'       THEN 'AI 爬蟲'
              WHEN ua_group LIKE 'googlebot%' THEN 'Googlebot 家族'
              WHEN ua_group = 'bingbot'       THEN 'bingbot'
              WHEN ua_group = 'seo-tool-bot'  THEN 'SEO 工具'
              WHEN ua_group = 'social-bot'    THEN '社群預覽'
              ELSE '其他 bot' END AS metric
  FROM crawl_daily WHERE ua_group <> 'human'
) t
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 誰在爬 vocus.cc（每小時請求數，不含真人）

panels.description: 用具名而非分群，因為同一個分群內的行為可以差很多：ai-mixed-bot 底下 amazonbot 錯誤率 7.1%、applebot 47.7%，差 6.7 倍。當初把 ua_name 放進儲存鍵就是為了保留這個拆解能力——Loki 只留 168h，事後想重新分類已經沒有原始資料。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ua_name AS "爬蟲", sum(request_count)::bigint AS "請求數"
FROM crawl_daily WHERE ua_group <> 'human'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 16

panels.title: 各爬蟲累計請求（具名，不含真人）

panels.description: 資料源是 gsc_page_daily 視圖，不是底表。底表把「頁面×裝置」與「關鍵字×裝置」兩套維度存在一起，直接對底表加總會得到約兩倍的假數字，而且不報錯。（2026-09-04 補：本圖限定 search_type='web'，與 panel 11／12 的 googleNews／Discover 分開，避免 Discover page 列自 2026-09-04 起加入 gsc_page_daily 後與 web 混算出現階梯狀失真。）

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamp AS time,
       sum(clicks)::bigint      AS "點擊",
       sum(impressions)::bigint AS "曝光"
FROM gsc_page_daily
WHERE property = 'https://vocus.cc/' AND search_type = 'web' AND $__timeFilter(date::timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Google 搜尋每日點擊與曝光

panels.description: 關鍵字維度每天被 API 的 5 萬列上限截斷（連續七天落在 47,832–48,048，波動不到 0.5%），缺的正好是長尾。所以這份排名可信，但「總共有多少關鍵字」不可信。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT query AS "關鍵字",
       sum(clicks)::bigint      AS "點擊",
       sum(impressions)::bigint AS "曝光",
       round((100.0 * sum(clicks) / NULLIF(sum(impressions), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "CTR %"
FROM gsc_query_daily
WHERE property = 'https://vocus.cc/' AND $__timeFilter(date::timestamp)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: 帶來最多點擊的關鍵字

panels.description: 刻意固定在單一維度組合（文章頁 × 行動裝置）。p75 不能跨維度重新聚合——把不同分群的 p75 平均起來會得到一個不對應任何真實使用者的數字。CLS 與 LoAF 單位不同，另外看。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT hour AS time, metric AS metric, p75 AS value
FROM cwv_hourly
WHERE environment = 'production' AND source = 'rum'
  AND route_type = '/article/[id]' AND device = 'mobile'
  AND metric IN ('LCP', 'INP', 'FCP', 'TTFB')
  AND $__timeFilter(hour)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 文章頁載入體驗 p75（行動裝置，production RUM）

panels.description: 回答「這頁零曝光是因為沒人搜，還是 Google 根本沒收錄」——這兩件事的處置完全相反，而在這條管線之前無法區分。URL is unknown to Google = Google 從沒看過這一頁。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coverage_state AS "狀態", count(*)::bigint AS "頁數"
FROM gsc_url_inspection
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Google 收錄狀態（抽樣）

panels.description:
錯誤率 = 狀態碼 >= 400 的請求占比，**跟隨上方時間範圍**。2026-09-07 修正：原本整表累計、不吃時間篩選，所以已經修好的問題在這裡看起來還在（406 的修復就是這樣被蓋掉的）。

拆出 404 / 406 / 5xx 才分得出性質：404 多半是爬蟲試舊網址，未必要修；406 是我們主動拒絕它（markdown content negotiation），可修；5xx 是我們自己壞掉，一定要修。錯誤率高不一定要修，但「不知道」與「知道且決定不修」是兩回事。

零錯誤的爬蟲原本會算出 NULL 並被 ORDER BY ... DESC 排到第一列（Postgres 預設 NULLS FIRST），已用 coalesce + NULLS LAST 修掉。

targets.rawSql:
WITH ts AS (
  SELECT (date::timestamp + (hour || ' hours')::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS t,
         ua_name, status_code, request_count
  FROM crawl_daily
  WHERE ua_group <> 'human'
)
SELECT ua_name AS "爬蟲",
       sum(request_count)::bigint AS "請求數",
       round((100.0 * coalesce(sum(request_count) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 400), 0)
              / NULLIF(sum(request_count), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "錯誤率 %",
       coalesce(sum(request_count) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 404), 0)::bigint AS "404",
       coalesce(sum(request_count) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 406), 0)::bigint AS "406",
       coalesce(sum(request_count) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 500), 0)::bigint AS "5xx"
FROM ts
WHERE $__timeFilter(t)
GROUP BY 1
HAVING sum(request_count) > 100
ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: 各爬蟲的錯誤率

panels.description:
**跟隨上方時間範圍**（2026-09-07 修正，原為整表累計，與左邊那張表口徑不一致）。

判斷要不要處理之前，注意兩件已知的刻意決策：三個 /api/ 前綴開放檢索是刻意的、不得提議收攏；某次 PR 造成的三個 app-webview 路徑 404 也是刻意的，屬已知非 regression。

targets.rawSql:
WITH ts AS (
  SELECT (date::timestamp + (hour || ' hours')::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS t,
         path_prefix, status_code, request_count
  FROM crawl_daily
  WHERE ua_group <> 'human' AND status_code >= 400
)
SELECT path_prefix AS "路徑", status_code AS "狀態碼",
       sum(request_count)::bigint AS "次數"
FROM ts
WHERE $__timeFilter(t)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: 爬蟲撞到錯誤的路徑（狀態碼 >= 400）

panels.description: 6 小時滾動加權錯誤率（區間內 sum(4xx/5xx) / sum(全部請求)，不是逐小時比率的平均，所以請求量少的小時不會把曲線拉歪）。旁邊那張「各爬蟲的錯誤率」表是全表累計、不吃時間選擇器；這張吃 $__timeFilter，修好東西之後看得出下降。crawl_daily 目前只從 2026-09-01 06:00 UTC 起算。

targets.rawSql:
WITH ts AS (
  SELECT (date::timestamp + (hour || ' hours')::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS t,
         ua_name, status_code, request_count
  FROM crawl_daily WHERE ua_group <> 'human'
),
top AS (
  SELECT ua_name FROM ts
  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(request_count) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 400) DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 10
),
hourly AS (
  SELECT t, ua_name,
         sum(request_count) AS reqs,
         coalesce(sum(request_count) FILTER (WHERE status_code >= 400), 0) AS errs
  FROM ts WHERE ua_name IN (SELECT ua_name FROM top) AND $__timeFilter(t)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT t AS time, ua_name AS metric,
       round((100.0 * sum(errs) OVER w / NULLIF(sum(reqs) OVER w, 0))::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM hourly
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ua_name ORDER BY t RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '5 hours' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 各爬蟲錯誤率趨勢（每小時，錯誤量前 10 名）

panels.description: 同樣是 6 小時滾動加權比率。PR #8116（legacy 文章 markdown 轉換 + middleware 依 RFC 9110 解析 Accept q 值）於 2026-09-03 約 03:00 UTC 上 prod，這條線在該時點斷崖式下降即為修復生效的證據。claude-user 每小時平均只有 4 個請求，單獨拉線沒有統計意義，已併入「全部爬蟲合計」。

targets.rawSql:
WITH ts AS (
  SELECT (date::timestamp + (hour || ' hours')::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS t,
         ua_name, status_code, request_count
  FROM crawl_daily WHERE ua_group <> 'human'
),
hourly AS (
  SELECT t,
         CASE WHEN ua_name IN ('exasearchbot', 'other-bot') THEN ua_name
              ELSE '其他爬蟲' END AS metric,
         sum(request_count) AS reqs,
         coalesce(sum(request_count) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 406), 0) AS errs
  FROM ts WHERE $__timeFilter(t)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t, '全部爬蟲合計' AS metric,
         sum(request_count) AS reqs,
         coalesce(sum(request_count) FILTER (WHERE status_code = 406), 0) AS errs
  FROM ts WHERE $__timeFilter(t)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT t AS time, metric,
       round((100.0 * sum(errs) OVER w / NULLIF(sum(reqs) OVER w, 0))::numeric, 2) AS value
FROM hourly
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY t RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '5 hours' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: markdown 協商 406 佔比趨勢（每小時）

panels.description: 資料源是 gsc_daily_totals，全站全量、與 GSC UI 同口徑（不是 gsc_page_daily／gsc_query_daily 的 top-N 抽樣）。2026-08-25 對照 GSC UI 介面數字，差異 0.00%。不可與抽樣表的加總相加。

panels.title: Discover 每日曝光與點擊

panels.description: 資料源是 gsc_page_daily 視圖（top-N 抽樣，非全量），search_type='googleNews'。Discover 的對應 page 層明細見 panel 14。

panels.title: googleNews 曝光前 20 頁面（區間內）

panels.description: 資料源是 gsc_page_daily 視圖（top-N 抽樣，非全量），search_type='discover'。device 恆為 'n/a'（Discover API 不支援裝置維度，S2.5 已 live 證實：400 cannot be grouped by device）。不可與 panel 12 的 totals（gsc_daily_totals，全量）相加。

targets.rawSql:

       sum(impressions)::bigint AS "曝光",
       sum(clicks)::bigint      AS "點擊"

panels.title: Discover 曝光前 20 頁面（區間內）
AI 答案能見度（AI SoV，週）

panels.description: sov_pooled：把所有 grounded 回應倒進同一個池子算比例，依 provider/model 拆成多條線。sov_macro 才是各主題等權重的官方判讀口徑（見 migration 024 註解），此圖用 sov_pooled 看每週趨勢。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT week_start::timestamp AS time,
       provider || '/' || model AS metric,
       round((100*sov_pooled)::numeric, 1) AS value
FROM ai_sov_weekly
WHERE $__timeFilter(week_start::timestamp)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: vocus 被 AI 回答引用的比例（每週）

panels.description: 跨所有 provider/model 彙總最新一週：SoV 與未搜尋比例用 sum(cited_responses)/sum(grounded_responses)（分別）重新聚合，不是直接挑某一個 provider 的 sov_pooled——同一週有多個 provider 時直接挑一列會漏掉其他樣本。回應數＝所有 provider 當週總回應數。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  round((100.0 * sum(cited_responses) / NULLIF(sum(grounded_responses), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "本週 SoV %",
  sum(responses)::bigint AS "回應數",
  round((100.0 * (1 - sum(grounded_responses)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(responses), 0)))::numeric, 1) AS "未搜尋比例 %"
FROM ai_sov_weekly
WHERE week_start = (SELECT max(week_start) FROM ai_sov_weekly)

panels.title: 本週 SoV／回應數／未搜尋比例

panels.description: 引用率 % 直接沿用 ai_sov_weekly_prompt.cite_rate（分母是 grounded 回應數，不是回答次數），該題該週零 grounded 回應時為 NULL，不是 0——不要當成「有機會但沒被引用」。同一題若同時跑多個 provider，會依「模型」欄拆成多列，非重複資料。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  prompt_id AS "題目 ID",
  prompt_theme AS "主題",
  provider || '/' || model AS "模型",
  responses AS "回答次數",
  cited_responses AS "引用次數",
  round((100 * cite_rate)::numeric, 1) AS "引用率 %"
FROM ai_sov_weekly_prompt
WHERE week_start = (SELECT max(week_start) FROM ai_sov_weekly)
ORDER BY "主題", "題目 ID", "模型"
